headline: Spain stroll, Carolina flops and Max still leads the parade
text: Spain (Grandad) were the big winners, easing past France (Carolina) 2-0, while Norway (Max) and England (Alex) shared the points and left both with a shrug. Argentina (Nana) and Switzerland (Jack) also nicked a draw, so no one’s exactly dancing in the streets there. Overall, Max is still top of the heap on 30 points, with Grandad breathing down the neck on 29. At the other end, Sofia is still propping up the table on 10 points, with Christopher not far ahead on 11. A proper scrap at both ends, that.
